name: miner
description: A headless Twitch drops miner for homelabs.

scripts.prepare: effect-tsgo patch --no-typescript --oxlint && (! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || lefthook install)
scripts.dev: vp pack && varlock run -- node dist/bin.mjs
scripts.schema: vp pack && node dist/bin.mjs config schema > schema/config.v1.json && vp fmt schema
